Wood fuel (charcoal and firewood), agricultural expansion, timber extraction, bush fires, and mining and infrastructural development are some of the main causes of deforestation in the country. In the Assisted Natural Forest Regeneration project, the Climate Smart Agriculture Alliance (CSAA) is working with farmers in the Central Province to manage the natural regeneration of deforested areas. Natural regeneration requires time and zero external intervention to flourish, SO farmers from local communities are trained in areas such as fire management and continuous monitoring to ensure that areas under regeneration are protected. Local farmers actively participate in the restoration and protection of the forest. They assume the role of traditional leaders who are considered the custodians of nature in such communities.
